verdict.rationale: Capsule documents the product-side building blocks of this story: importing contacts from a spreadsheet or CSV, creating pipelines, and drag-and-drop stage management. Sign-in with existing Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts eases starting up. Nothing in the evidence addresses time-to-value, a self-serve setup flow, or doing it without a partner. Missing for 10: evidence of an under-an-hour signup-to-pipeline path, guided onboarding or setup wizard, import of opportunities/pipeline data (not just contacts), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that setup needs no implementation partner.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Bring your contacts to Capsule by importing them from a spreadhseet, CSV and more.
Create multiple pipelines to reflect different sales processes for products and services you offer and different markets that you sell to.
See all your opportunities in one pipeline, drag and drop to each stage as they progress.
Log in to Capsule using your existing Google Workspace email and password.
